cohort: 1032 women who gave birth to singleton infants
finding: Higher D-dimer levels, lower antithrombin activity, and lower fibrinogen levels in late gestation, along with maternal age ≥35 years, BMI >28.2 kg/m2, and previous cesarean delivery were independent risk factors for PPH.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage.
